runnerProtocol.workloads: exact seven expectedResults names except shutdown.request

limitations: Fixture preparation only; no guest has executed and no libc or distribution boot qualification is implied.
BusyBox/glibc shell workloads only; no systemd service manager or general-purpose distribution qualification.
The final poweroff helper uses klibc; it is not one of the seven glibc workload checks.
Shell process isolation and exec/wait semantics; exact fork/clone/vfork syscall choice is not traced.
64 KiB shell allocation/copy only; no malloc/mmap stress or exhaustion contract.
USR1 handler and sleep/uptime only; no complete signal or timer syscall coverage.
Writable tmpfs only; no block filesystem persistence qualification.
